analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,085,000 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (1,131,600 KRW / 1,273,100 KRW / 1,490,980 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends confirmed
· Position vs SMA100/200 (1,655,628 KRW / 1,528,524 KRW): Below long-term trends, entering weak territory
· 52-week position (29.9%) + Current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.1 → 37.9): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues
· MACD histogram trajectory (314.0351 → -1743.5036): Worsening continues, bearish trend strengthening
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 1,006,167 KRW): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,089,000 KRW): Aligns with 5-day low, potential short-term support role
· Swing resistance (1,317,000 KRW): High level relative to current price, bullish reversal signal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low (1,092,000 KRW) > 20-day low (1,089,000 KRW), no Higher Low pattern confirmed, potential for sideways or continued weakness
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.95x): Normal level, moderate confidence in current movement
· Current phase diagnosis: Downtrend phase, with RSI entering oversold and MACD worsening, additional downside potential remains. ADX trend weak, making directional confirmation difficult, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
